title: Tidewater
tagline: 海边钓鱼游戏，展示自研 WebGPU 引擎、海浪与大气渲染

examples.title: 钓鱼拉力
examples.one_liner: 收线与松线控制拉力，观察钓获、断线和逃脱结果
examples.one_liner_en: Reel in or release to control tension and observe catches, snapped lines and escapes.

examples.title: 海浪与浮力
examples.one_liner: 切换海况，驾驶原版小船，观察浮标与船体随浪起伏
examples.one_liner_en: Switch sea states, drive the original boat and watch buoys and the hull rise and fall with the waves.

tagline_en: Seaside fishing with a custom WebGPU engine, ocean waves and atmospheric rendering.
